results.answer: On the final test (314 wafers, 17 failures), the static policy achieves PR-AUC of 0.075 and ROC-AUC of 0.627 (recall 0.118, precision 0.062, FNR 0.882). For label lag 0, adaptive policies show slightly lower or equal PR-AUC (0.068) compared to static. For label lag 1, adaptive policies show PR-AUC of 0.087 to 0.089 (d_pr_auc_vs_static of +0.012 to +0.014). However, because there are very few failures, all confidence intervals for the differences include zero, so we cannot claim a statistically significant benefit from adapting.
results.uncertainty: The final test contains very few failures (17 out of 314 wafers), leading to wide confidence intervals that include zero for all performance differences.
